The immediate post-closure cutter command and TCP must match the final forward waypoint, within 1e-6 command units, 0.5 mm in position and 1 degree in orientation. Capture a pre-reverse narrow reference, then replay the preceding distinct cutter commands in exact reverse order with the original guarded setToolPose and 15 settling steps. Enforce at most 4 reverse segments. Inspect the same closed, pose and safety interlocks on every new observation; one refusal fails closed, without retry or fallback. Use no old optics to certify the new endpoint.
gate: At the recorded cleared pose capture identical review optics without requiring a live wide front. Persist pre/post structure for offline scoring; require identical constraints, independent exact 8 and 9 mm on separate trajectories, no faults and exact BELOW(8)/TARGET(9) on the cleared RGB-D (raw and deterministic 0.5 mm noise).
